answer: An admission auction charges every identity. Each epoch offers 20 slots; agents bid POA, winners pay, losers are refunded. A sybil attacker wanting 100 fakes must outbid honest agents 100 times, crossing a reef of rising prices. Each fake enters as a vertex in the referral graph, marked umber, earning nothing for 10 epochs, so the attacker locks 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA upfront. An honest agent pays one 50 POA bid once and keeps its full share.
